component.name: Plezy
component.summary: Watch and listen to your Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby libraries

description.p: Plezy is a media client for Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby servers. Browse your libraries, stream video and music, and download media for offline playback. Plezy provides no content of its own.
Playback uses mpv with support for subtitles, multiple audio tracks, playback speed controls, and hardware video decoding on supported systems. Video playback needs a Wayland session.
